strings.apply_the_reviewed_values_write_each_cho: 应用已检查的值。上方每个选择写作 target=source（按键绑定写作 binding:target=shortcut），用分号分隔。

strings.the_product_refused_this_data_file_edit: 该产品拒绝了此数据文件编辑。
strings.adjust_this_value_within_its_allowed_ran: Adjust this value within its allowed range.
strings.change_this_world_s_override_the_config_: Change this world's override. The config fallback remains unchanged.
strings.change_who_may_edit_this_setting_only_th: Change who may edit this setting. Only the owning system can grant permission.
strings.choose_console_messages_and_log_detail_t: Choose console messages and log detail. These controls affect logging, not gameplay.
strings.choose_how_much_detail_appears_in_mod_lo: Choose how much detail appears in mod logs. Higher verbosity produces more diagnostic messages.
strings.choose_which_mods_or_visible_settings_to: Choose which mods or visible settings to include in a saved profile. This does not change their current values.
strings.close_the_settings_window_accepted_chang: Close the settings window. Accepted changes are already applied; changes requiring a restart are summarized first.
strings.close_the_tools_window_only_changes_you_: Close the tools window. Only changes you explicitly applied are saved.
strings.collapse_or_expand_every_settings_sectio: Collapse or expand every settings section for the selected mod. Search results remain expanded.

strings.cycle_the_console_filter_level_for_this_: Cycle the console filter level for this log source. The counters show written and hidden messages.
strings.edit_data_files_registered_by_installed_: Edit data files registered by installed mods. Each mod validates and saves its own files.
strings.edit_the_serialized_value_as_text_valida: Edit the serialized value as text. Validation and permissions still apply.
strings.edit_this_coordinate_confirm_to_apply_th: Edit this coordinate. Confirm to apply the complete value.
strings.enter_a_number_or_use_the_buttons_to_adj: Enter a number, or use the buttons to adjust it within its allowed range.
strings.enter_a_value_then_confirm_to_apply_it: Enter a value, then confirm to apply it.
strings.enter_console_filter_rules_here_before_c: Enter console filter rules here before choosing Use text. Rules use source=level, separated by semicolons.
strings.enter_only_the_choices_requested_by_the_: Enter only the choices requested by the conversion preview, separated by semicolons. Review the complete plan before applying.
strings.exit_the_game_after_closing_this_summary: Exit the game after closing this summary so restart-required changes can take effect on the next launch.
strings.filter_matching_console_messages_without: Filter matching console messages without changing gameplay or the underlying mod settings.
strings.full_json_path_for_importing_or_exportin: Full JSON path for importing or exporting a profile. Existing export files are not overwritten.
strings.include_keyboard_shortcuts_when_saving_a: Include keyboard shortcuts when saving a profile. Imported shortcuts still use normal validation.
strings.include_or_exclude_this_mod_when_saving_: Include or exclude this mod when saving a hand-picked profile.
strings.include_or_exclude_this_value_from_the_p: Include or exclude this value from the pending profile application. Nothing changes until Apply.
strings.include_specialist_settings_in_the_saved: Include specialist settings in the saved profile, even when they are hidden from the ordinary settings view.
strings.keep_accepted_changes_and_return_to_the_: Keep accepted changes and return to the game. Restart-required changes take effect after restarting.
strings.manage_the_selected_mod_s_configuration_: Manage the selected mod's configuration files, including reload, backups, reset and text editing. Permissions still apply.
strings.match_all_search_words_quote_an_exact_ph: Match all search words, quote an exact phrase, or exclude a word with a leading minus sign.
strings.name_the_profile_to_save_or_import_exist: Name the profile to save or import. Existing profile names are not overwritten.
strings.narrow_the_visible_settings_selected_fil: Narrow the visible settings. Selected filters must all match; clear every selection to show all settings.
strings.open_the_editor_for_this_setting: Open the editor for this setting.
strings.open_the_full_list_of_choices: Open the full list of choices.
strings.pin_or_unpin_the_selected_mod_at_the_top: Pin or unpin the selected mod at the top of the list. This only changes your local display order.
strings.preview_restoring_this_section_s_setting: Preview restoring this section's settings to their defaults. Locked and hidden settings remain protected.
strings.preview_settings_imported_from_supported: Preview settings imported from supported mods before applying them. The producing mod validates each conversion.
strings.preview_this_saved_profile_and_review_di: Preview this saved profile and review differences before applying any values.
strings.read_the_supported_source_and_preview_it: Read the supported source and preview its proposed changes. This action does not apply them.
strings.restore_this_setting_s_value_from_before: Restore this setting's value from before this session. Remote server changes cannot be undone here.
strings.save_only_values_that_differ_from_their_: Save only values that differ from their defaults. Turn off to include unchanged values too.
strings.save_preview_import_or_restore_groups_of: Save, preview, import or restore groups of settings. Applying a profile still checks each mod's permissions.
strings.shared_setting_changes_follow_the_server: Shared setting: changes follow the server's permissions.
strings.show_keyboard_shortcuts_and_shared_key_c: Show keyboard shortcuts and shared-key conflicts. This replaces the current filters.
strings.show_specialist_settings_search_can_stil: Show specialist settings. Search can still find matching advanced settings when this switch is off.
strings.this_mod_did_not_supply_a_description: This mod did not supply a description.
strings.on_applies_the_console_filter_to_logoutp: On applies the console filter to LogOutput.log too. Off keeps the disk log complete even when console messages are filtered.
strings.open_actions_for_this_configuration_file: Open actions for this configuration file.
strings.each_player_sets_this_for_themselves_it_: 每位玩家各自设置。仅在这台电脑上生效，并随你的配置档保存。

strings.cfg_general__toggle_key_help: 用于打开 Almanac 的可选快捷键。默认不绑定按键，因为游戏菜单中已有“模组设置”。

strings.cfg_general__pinned_plugins_help: 置顶模组的标识符，用逗号分隔。日常修改请使用工具栏中的“置顶”或“取消固定”；此字段用于高级手动编辑。
strings.cfg_compatibility__coexistence_help: Auto：避开其他配置管理器的 F1。AlwaysOwnKey：始终使用“打开快捷键”，按键冲突时仅给出警告。
strings.cfg_display__show_unbound_files_help: 以只读文本列出没有任何运行中模组加载的配置文件。
strings.cfg_display__show_empty_plugins_help: 显示没有可见设置的插件。
strings.cfg_display__highlight_changes_help: 为偏离默认值或在本次会话中更改过的设置着色并加上标签。
strings.cfg_changes__restart_phrases_help: 表示需要重启的额外提示语，用逗号分隔。
strings.cfg_changes__watch_files_on_disk_help: 报告外部对配置文件的更改，且不覆盖未保存的编辑。
strings.cfg_changes__journal_size_kb_help: 本次会话更改日志的最大大小，单位为 KiB。
strings.cfg_profiles__backup_count_help: 每个文件保留的备份数量。
strings.cfg_window__default_dock_position_help: 保留的 ConfigDrawers 导入偏好。Almanac 目前使用浮动窗口；此值不会使其停靠。

strings.cfg_window__pause_game_help: Almanac 打开时暂停游戏（仅限可暂停的单人游戏）。绝不会解除并非由 Almanac 造成的暂停。
strings.cfg_window__window_opacity_help: 设置窗口的透明程度。1 表示完全不透明。
